description: Render L_water-flow, B_water-flow, B_continuation, B_entrance (currently invisible) and fix B_blocks (currently dropped) as real TopoDroid-style vector icons, shared identically across the matplotlib survey plot, the Folium satellite HTML view, and the KML/KMZ Google Earth export. Backend-only (cave_sketch/ package) — ships to both the webapp and the Android app automatically via the existing Chaquopy symlink.
